reviews.text: My Favorite Way to Practice. Sarah Beth is my absolute favorite yoga teacher. Her style of teaching is precise, soothing and professional. I’m able to completely relax during her classes, which is very hard for me to do. Plus, the app is very well designed and easy to navigate. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Best. I’ve been with SBY over 7 years, started on YouTube and now on the app. The experience is so wonderful. There are so many options for videos and calendars. I love learning something new. It’s so grounding, it’s perfect.
Daily practice. Love!! I practice yoga daily with SarahBeth.

Life-changing. I started Sara Beth when I was recovering from a chronic health condition. Her practice then fully matched up with what I learn and study in AYURVEDA. Her videos are quiet and carefully coached! I am able to do things I could never do if I just went to the class! Also it helped me lose weight without knowing! Her knowledge is growing and she actually listens to her loyal members! Go SBY!

Beginner. I have wanted to start yoga for a while.
I feel intimidated in class environments. 
I love how Sarah Beth Yoga is great for beginners to advanced. 
The app is easy to follow . 
I love how I can build my practice in the privacy of my own home and on the road.

Best Ever. I started using this App during COVID when my studio shut down and I never stopped! Sarah Beth is wonderful. Her voice is soothing and her instructions clear. I love the flexibility of yoga at home. Anything I need from 5 minutes to 60, specific body parts, kinds of yoga: I could go on and on. This App keeps me disciplined and grounded. I highly recommend it!

Loyalist. I am a loyal Sarah Beth patron and have been since I stumbled on it with YouTube. Since I’ve gotten the app, I haven’t looked back. The calendars are smart and well-curated. I’m a better person because I practice yoga and participate in the community. The app has enriched my life.

Worth the investment!. I love watching ad free and I like that the app keeps up with the videos I have completed and lets me choose favorites. The programs are great too. I’m working on the 8 week trauma healing program and it’s amazing how much of a difference just 5 or 10 minutes a day can make. Having the app helps keep me more consistent with a daily yoga practice.
Perfect way to practice from home!. Love Sarah Beth and how she instructs! I’m not really into going to a full class, so this has been the perfect alternative.

Excellent. I’ve been doing SBY on YouTube for 3 years! I absolutely love the ease of being able to use an app when my kids are using the tv or when I’m not readily in a room where I can watch one of her classes. I’m currently doing the 21 day challenge and supplementing with extra videos every morning and I just love the flow! Thank you!!

Love that I can stop and renew anywhere with this app on my phone. I have been following SB for about 2 years and doing yoga with her YouTube videos. Having the app is especially great because I can do yoga anytime and have it when I’m traveling. 

The meditation videos are something I have been using a lot. Having her calming voice and a variety of meditations to choose from has been extremely beneficial when my anxiety flares. 

Highly recommend this app!

Wowza! SBY is friendly for ALL abilities. I followed SBY on you tube on and off for a few years. I couldn’t get into a rhythm and wasn’t sure where to start. When SBY released her birthday special for the app and membership, I snagged the deal and I’m so so happy I did. The app gave me a starting point by having calendar to follow along with. While I wasn’t necessarily a beginner, I certainly wouldn’t qualify as an intermediate, I went ahead and started with the beginner calendar and I’m glad I did. I was a refresher on how to flow properly and the prompts she gives are spot and and at the exact time I need them (example: “keep shoulders soft, keep core engaged, hips aligned)! There is a daily calendar that has preloaded routines for you OR you can add your own routine from her collection or calendar programs. When completing them, a little green check mark appears and gosh it’s great to see a green check mark as a way to keep track and keep me motivated. I highly recommend this app, especially to beginners. Sarah Beth, you were exactly where I needed you to be for me to snag the birthday special. Thank you!

SarahBethYoga app delivers. After thoroughly enjoying one of Sarah Beth's yoga challenges on YouTube, I decided to invest in a 3-month subscription to her app, and it’s been one of the best decisions for my practice. The app is impressively organized, with a vast library of videos that are easy to navigate. I appreciate Sarah Beth’s teaching style her simple breakdown of poses and personalized practice options make each session both accessible and effective. I’m currently working through her Beginner to Yogi program and am excited to continue exploring all the app has to offer.

Changed My Life. Sarah Beth has changed my life! I had back problems and needed PT and my therapist recommended SBY! I religiously do a youtube yoga practice every day now and feel so much better! It’s amazing to start my day off like that! SarahBeth’s instructions are so clear I hardly need to reference the tv, and I am new to yoga! Thank you SarahBeth! 🧘‍♀️🩷

SBY App. I first met Sarah Beth at a local club she was teaching at in Denver Colorado. She was the best teacher there but eventually I had to move from Denver to Vancouver British Columbia, but I didn’t have to leave Sarah Beth in Denver because she released an app shortly after that and I have been able to continue yoga with her for five years. I tried some local yoga studios here, but none of them gave me near the amount of choices and teaching, and overall health benefit that this app does. This is all you need for the rest of your life. Literally, you can grow old with all of the choices. She has in this app for different ages and levels.

Variety, options and motivation. I have really enjoyed this app and appreciated being able to engage in SarahBeth Yoga! I like the community aspect, the daily yoga options when I’m unsure of what I want to do for that day, and the themed monthly yoga options. This app has provided me with the motivation to complete yoga on a more consistent basis :)

Great yoga app. I have done yoga on and off over the years and always enjoyed it but didn’t really understand exactly what I was doing. I also wanted to yoga in my own on my own time. 

So I hunted through the internet and found various yoga videos eventually coming across Sarah Beth. I really liked her style, but just plucking them off YouTube wasn’t really doing it for me. Then I tried the app and now I have all this curated content and I can evolve my practice as I want to and understand what I am doing. It was a breakthrough for me! I’m so glad I found it.
Best app!!. I love waking up every morning doing yoga! This app is the best and so easy to use.

Great Yoga Instruction. I highly recommend Sarah Beth’s yoga videos and app. I started yoga about 4 years ago and came across her videos on YouTube. Her yoga videos offer great instruction, are easy to follow with modifications for different levels. I learned so much from her. Sarah Beth also uploads new videos on a regular basis. I highly recommend the calendars in the app. They help target whatever you want to focus on in your routine. Check it out!

Superb Yoga Instruction. Sarah Beth and her Yoga app are great! I am incredibly grateful for Sarah Beth's content and have followed her now for 3 years. I was a yoga newbie and appreciated her videos greatly. Her yoga routines are easy to follow and she uploads new ones on a regular basis. Sarah Beth provides modifications in most (if not all) of her videos to accommodate different levels. Highly recommend checking her out!

Favorite Yoga App and Instructor!. I’ve been watching Sarah Beth Yoga on YouTube for the last six months and I love the convenience of the app! The calendar already having a video for each day is so helpful for when you’re ready to get a quick session in. Sarah Beth’s instructions and support in her videos are very encouraging. I’m always eager to do a second video :)

Start a daily yoga habit. SarahBeth is my fav YouTube yogi. I bought the app and I’m so glad I did! I love the full length classes and calendars particularly. It’s definitely worth what you pay for it - recommend!

Great app to keep you motivated!. I highly recommend the SarahBethYoga app for anyone interested in yoga, no matter what your skill level! Sarah Beth’s narration is very encouraging and calming. I also appreciate the variety of yoga videos (style, area of focus, time, skill level, etc) so that you can choose what is best for you. There are also so many videos exclusive to the app that have been very helpful in my daily practice.

Best yoga teacher out there ❤️. I absolutely LOVE Sarah Beth’s yoga videos. I started practicing her videos on YouTube back in 2020 and had to subscribe to the app shortly after because I NEEDED the longer and exclusive content. She made me fell in love with yoga and I actually ended up pursuing a yoga teacher training. Although I am a certified yoga teacher now I still practice with her videos EVERY. SINGLE. DAY. Because I like not having to think about what to do on my flow and to just follow a very well thought out yoga class. 
The last time I subscribe to the app I couldn’t link my email account to my subscription for some reason. I ended up reaching out to the Sarah Beth Yoga support team and they were extremely helpful. Megan did not give up on me and kept working with their developers to solve my problem, and of course, they ended up solving my problem. They were very helpful and caring throughout the whole process. 
Thank you so much Sarah Beth for bringing yoga to my life and to so many others’ life. You helped me through hard times and also helped me celebrate through the good times ✨
Couldn’t recommend this app more ❤️

Such a great support. I’ve watched the free stuff on Sarah’s YouTube for years, but the app has added a level of intentionality I could not have produced so well. I’m so happy to have the Trauma plan to work alongside the book too! In the future I’m sure I’ll use the calendar too. It’s nice to not have to ponder which video to choose.

Best yoga app for busy moms. I have tried so many yoga and fitness apps and this is the one I always come back to. Sarah Beth is kind and straight forward. She doesn’t waste your time with a lot of nonsense and I love the calendar. When things are at the worst I still have time for a 5 min practice and can always find something that meets what I need for the day. Love this app and can’t go without it.

Best Yoga app ever. The SarahBethYoga app gives me everything I need on any given day. If you only have 5 minutes, there are many 5 minute options and you always receive a good workout. I would recommend her app to anyone at any age. I am 62 and love it. Thanks Sara Beth!

Amazing Yoga App!. I highly recommend Sarah Beth’s videos for your yoga practice because she is purposeful, kind, creative and uplifting in her practice. I began watching her videos at the start of the pandemic and have learned everything I know from her. Even after 4 years of practicing yoga with her videos this app offers new content and videos to further grow my practice. I love how easy it is to look for a video based on what you need (length, type of yoga, focus areas) but you also have the option to follow the monthly calendar in the app which is fun and helpful to take the work out of finding your video each day. This app makes doing yoga anywhere so easy and I also love how it highlights the videos you’ve already done. Try it out!!

The app is so worth it!. I started out with the 21 day challenge on YouTube with my SIL. We both enjoyed it so much we decided to get the app and continue daily yoga together. I love that the app is so informative. This app makes it so much less intimidating as a beginner and easy to follow along. I love that there are often alternatives given for the poses. Also, having a dedicated section to really see and understand each pose was super helpful. I am feeling healthier and stronger each day with the app. There are so many options to choose for your daily practice. The app has been totally worth it and become part of my daily routine.

From YouTube to App…DO IT!. I found SarahBeth on YouTube when I first got into giving this “yoga” stuff a try. Though I sampled a number of creators, SarahBeth’s videos were the ones I kept returning to. When she came out with an app, yeah, I had to give it a try. 

I was hooked! It was so great to have the routines all in one place, and I loved the calendars. 

At some point, I fell away from my practice and let my subscription lapse…. When I got back on the “yoga track,” I tried to just go back to YouTube…but no. I missed the app. 

I rejoined…and WOW, the whole app has gotten even *better,* and I didn’t think that was possible!

I still love the calendars, I love the daily suggested routines, I love the community…there’s still so much to explore!

If you enjoy SarahBeth on YouTube and are wondering if the app is worth it…YES! It is!

New to Yoga? This app is a must!. I'm a 50+ year-old woman who has never done yoga and decided I needed something new in my life to inspire me. Sarah Beth yoga is a not just inspirational, but a game changer. I now look forward every day to going to her app and choosing a new new yoga session that always make me feel awesome after I'm done. Sara Beth is encouraging and calming and engages you to learn yoga at your own pace with wonderful results. I have never felt better. My flexibility and strength are inspiring me in many other ways now and I can't imagine not starting my day without Sara Beth!

Finally joined a Yoga program.. Started with the free videos. After wanting more, I decided to join through the app. The Calendar function is amazing which varies the daily video. I especially enjoy the program calendars all found in one spot. Overall the app seems stable and very simple to use. Looking forward to do more programs after I finish the current one.

I love this app!. I’m 40 years old and about 30lbs overweight. My sister-in-law and I wanted to lose weight and started the 21 day yoga challenge that’s free on YouTube. We loved it so much that we both bought a subscription to the app and are doing the beginner to yogi program that teaches how to do the poses. 

It’s week 6 doing SBY, and my belly is thinner around, I feel stronger, the pain in my back is better, it’s easier to bend down to pick up my fur babies and clean the house, and I feel like I have more energy and am happier in general. If I knew yoga could make me feel so good. I would’ve started years ago.

I like SBY because when I wake up in the morning and dread getting up and exercising, I remind myself that her videos are totally achievable, and when I finish a video, I think that wasn’t too hard, I can totally do this. Whereas a 60 or 90 minute in-person yoga class in the past has made me feel defeated, like it was unachievable. 

Plus, there’s a calendar in the app, this is the main reason I bought a subscription to the app. The calendar has 1 or 2 recommended videos every day in the calendar, so no stress over what video to do that day. I’m looking forward to starting the calendar after finishing beginner to yogi program. 

I’m a military spouse and like how it’s an app and can have the comfort and stability of a practice I can continue no matter where we move. Plus I love all the positive, motivational quotes like, “you are exactly where you need to be.”

I would highly recommend this app. Thanks SBY!

It’s like she knows what I’m thinking.. Sarah Beth is super easy to follow, her voice is very calming, she’s very clear on what to focus on in your poses. I’ve searched a LOT of yoga instructors. She is by far my favorite!

Sarah Beth Yoga is FIRE!!!. New to yoga? Experienced yogi who needs some change in her life? This is your one stop shop! So many videos for all different types of skill levels! Sarah Beth Yoga is hands down the best yoga app out there!

Enriching Wellness with Intuitive Classes for All Levels. I have been using the SarahBethYoga app for the past month, which has been enriching. The user interface is intuitive, with classes for all levels. It's become crucial to my wellness routine, offering diverse classes for physical and mental well-being. Great for beginners and seasoned practitioners alike.

Best yoga instructor and app of all time!. Sarah Beth is a game changer! This app is amazing. The daily calendar giving a video to do each day and changing it up to start your day strong as changed me. Mentally and physically. So grateful to her and her app. You won’t regret this purchase for your life!

SBY App. Love the SBY app! I’ve been a member since 2017/2018, the best investment for me! There are so many videos and calendars so no matter how I’m feeling I can always find a video. AND there are so many different length options- you don’t always need to commit to a full 60 mins. I do a lot of the 5-10 min videos when I’m short on time but still want to practice.
I finally did it!. I have followed SBY on YouTube for a couple years. I finally became a member and downloaded the app. Wow!! Here it is, all organized and easy to find what I want/need.

Beginner Male, Age 63. Prior to signing up to Sarah Beth Yoga I wasn’t sure I could accomplish the goals of a Yogi. Within a week, all doubts are gone! I look forward to my daily yoga and while I have far to go I can’t imagine not practicing! Thank you Sarah Beth fo this awesome journey!

Yoga Therapy. Sarah Beth is an amazing yoga instructor, probably the best you can find online. I first followed her on YouTube, starting from her 12M reviewed debloating yoga video. Her videos are of no frills, teaching you exactly the right postures, movements and mindset on and off the mat. The app is a treasure for yogis. There’re different kinds of calendars and programs, ranging from weight loss to pregnancy care (and many more). I’m a calendar person and I love those challenges like the 7 day, 30 day morning yoga, etc. I learn a lot and have fun by doing my daily practice through the app.

Best yoga teacher/app ever. I’ve been following Sarah Beth Yoga for years on YouTube and I’ve never looked back since discovering her. She is the best yoga instructor ever! No yoga instructor has ever come close, in my opinion! When I found out she had an app, I had to get it. And I’ve never been disappointed for a second. Her app has literally changed my life. It’s so user-friendly and I can’t believe how easy it is to search for any type of video/style/length of yoga you’d like to do. I’m obsessed! Thank you Sarah Beth and team for all you do!

LOVE THIS APP!. I was new to Yoga and found Sara Beth’s video on You Tube among others. I found myself searching for hers due to her calm, but strong demeanor and depth of knowledge about yoga. I decided to get her app and I’ve been a faithful user for years now. It is organized so well saving me time in the morning to get to exactly what I want. It’s very clever with many ways to search to get just the right workout. She even has workouts for your feet which helped me with a bit of Planter’s Faciitis. There are just so many options to find specifically what your body needs. She has put a lot of heart, effort and thought into an excellent app that I know you will love.

Getting stronger every single day. I subscribed for the app 8 months ago. It was my 1st experience with doing yoga. And what a difference it makes!
I actually had trouble breathing for a year after long covid at that time. Slowly, month by month I started noticing the difference. I don’t have trouble breathing any more. I became more active, more positive and more confident. I am still at a very moderate level of yoga exercises, but I do them every morning and when time allows, during the day and evening. Those stretches are amazing for my lower back. Love the app! Love Sarah’s voice and soft guidance.

Excellent yoga!. SarahBethYoga content is diverse, welcoming and well-structured for all levels, all in an easy to use platform. Access to the calendars and live videos is great! Her style is simple and professional, and the mental stimulation and quotes she provides substantially enhance the physical practice. I hate to miss a day!

Suitable for all ages. I’ve enjoyed SarahBeth for a few years, first on YouTube and now in the app. Love the app, membership allows so many videos! Great coaching, warm and understanding while being encouraging, easy to listen to, and just a bit of humor in the right places. Videos are accessible with modifications often displayed, so when I have those not so young feeling days I can still complete a program. Seniors are not limited to chair yoga! I joined a local “not for raw beginners” class recently - when the instructor inquired of my experience, I don’t think she was impressed with my online background. Coolest thing ever when she came to me after class to acknowledge good prep and yoga education. Yay, SarahBeth quality teaching! Thank you for plenty of variety, high quality, and new material always coming out.

Love! Love! Love!. I started about a year ago, and I love this app because I love the style of teaching. You can be any level and get benefit from the teaching. The instructions for each pose or transition are described in a way that teach you how to keep yourself from being injured. And my favorite phrase, “it’s a practice not a perfect,” I’ve been able to take into my everyday life.

The BEST👍🏻💕. If you’re looking for the BEST Yoga app, look no further! Sarah Beth Yoga offers all types of Yoga in a very organized and user friendly way. You would never get confused to follow or what to do next. The most appealing part for me to follow SBY though is her calming voice and attitude during the sessions. No other Yoga videos by various Yogis worked for me to actually feel good, enjoy the process and relax. So, I sticked with SBY and became a member. My body&soul appreciates what SB does for us! Thanks

SBY is the best!. For years, I had been trying to find a quality yoga studio. I went to a few in my area, but the class times and locations were never convenient and never coincided with my schedule for me to be consistent. I have some experience with my martial arts training so I was really looking to take my yoga practice to the next level. In 2020…being stuck at home…I stumbled upon SarahBeth on YouTube and I immediately fell in love!! I was drawn to her professionalism…her calming voice, the music and I absolutely love how she voices over the videos of her physical movements, it makes it very easy to follow along. I also, love the convenience of being able to perform whenever I want too on my own schedule. I recently downloaded the app and joined the community….it was the best decision I made. I have access to WAY more videos, I love the calendar to keep myself honest and consistent and I love connecting with other like minded individuals. If you are looking for fantastic quality, at home yoga sessions you must try SarahBeth Yoga! She is outstanding!!

Positive review. I found Sara Beth yoga a few years ago on YouTube and have been practicing with her since. When I discovered her app, I was hooked and loved how much easier it was and helped me wherever I needed.

Truly Beginner Friendly. When I first began my search on Youtube for beginner yoga videos most of them were fast paced, and started in post that a true beginner had no idea of form, and what a pose should feel like, or look like. I began to be a bit discouraged, and I was not ready for a public class experience. I finally found one of the Sarah Beth videos and I felt so connected, and I felt like I could learn yoga. I started with the free 6 week beginner to yogi program. Before the six weeks were up I was ready to join. One of the many things I truly love about her method and style is that I can close my eyes, follow her instructions, and not have to be constantly staring at the screen trying to mimic her movements. Sarah guides you through it , giving tips on what and where you should be feeling a pose, and at the same time checking in that you are not caving your body into poor form. I strongly recommend this app, and I have told many people about it who are also searching to start a beginner program that will lead you into your path of advancement, strength, and flexibility.

Excellent value. . I did the Sarah Beth routines for years using YouTube but I finally bought the app and I’m so glad I did. It’s a Huge value. There are 100’s of routines in all kinds of categories.
 I use the calendar which has daily routines encouraging me to try new things and just do it everyday. 
I also love the Sunday live routine which feels like a live class and has lots of discussion time of very thoughtful topics. Sarah Beth gives so much of herself to everything she does.

Yoga with Sarah. Love this App. Sarah is a pro and has many videos for a beginner or the advanced. Sarah has many tutorials for almost any body part. I’m excited to implement her routines into my daily practice. I really enjoyed her first video I watched and practiced too. I feel great today. I can see this is gonna be totally helpful. 

Nick Spaniak
3/27/2024

SBY. I’ve used SBY for nearly 5 years on and off from YouTube to finally pulling the trigger on the app. I’m a casual yogi with back problems and anxiety. She consistently helps keep me grounded and feeling right! The app is fantastic.

Simply wonderful. Sarah Beth’s app is great! Her live yoga classes are incredibly personal, fun, and edifying. She has all kinds of great calendars for: grief, trauma, challenges, etc. It’s easy to use! She answers questions live during her lives / live yoga classes.

10 minutes a day!. I found SarahBeth on YouTube when Covid hit and needed some kind of daily routine. She got me with the hook of “10 minutes a day is all you need” to join and this has rung true for me. 5,10,25 minutes fits perfectly into my daily routine, first thing in the morning. I love, love, love, her calendars that are focused and tell me what to do on the days I don’t want to decide. But I also love the freedom to pick a workout by length, difficulty, and style on the days when this suits. The app calendar has been a game changer and lets me keep my yoga calendar digitally with the option to mix and match as my day requires. If you’re looking for convenient, non-judgmental content for your practice (not your perfect) then you’re in the right place!

The only fitness app I’ve purchased. I love the Sarah Beth Yoga App! It is easy to navigate and there are many videos of various lengths, focus and styles. There are also videos on meditation, breath work, yoga tips and pose breakdowns. New videos and materials are added frequently and there are live sessions!

Great instruction in the privacy of my own home!. Thanks to SBY, I love yoga! I never would have braved going to a club or YMCA to learn how to do yoga in front of other people. When I think of all the times I've tipped over in my living room, there's just no way I'd want to make that public! I've tried other yoga instruction, but Sarah Beth's instructions are so easy to follow without being too much. As time goes on, I trust myself more and more in her minimal cues videos. The membership has been so worth it. My fitness has improved, and it's kept me away from the chiropractor as well!
Love Sarah Beth. I’ve had this app for years and it's my go to for home yoga. Great app and she is always adding more.

Fantastic yoga app. I’ve been using this app for over a year and I love it. A wide variety of yoga videos with every variation, style and length you could want. Sarah Beth is an excellent teacher who can walk her students from beginners to experienced yogis in a short period of time. The online community is fun and makes you feel like you aren’t alone in your journey. I also enjoy her live sessions which run once a week currently. Well worth the membership.

Peaceful and revitalizing yoga experience and practice!. I’ve been practicing with SBY since 2017 - I still remember when I discovered her teaching. I was on maternity leave after having my daughter and the doctor had just blessed me to start moving / exercising again. I decided to renew my yoga practice and SBY’s calming voice drew me into her practice. And to this day, I’m coming back regularly to hear her calming voice and diverse selection of classes to move my body mindfully, strengthen my mind and focus and feel more grounded and at peace afterwards. Thank you SBY!!

One thankful yogi. I’m so thankful I found Sarah Beth yoga. I have suffered with chronic pain for a long time. I found Sarah Beth yoga on YouTube couple years ago, and then joined her community. I can’t tell you enough how this has helped me mentally and physically. I absolutely love her app. It is very easy to use, she has so many videos to choose from. I like that I can choose what I am feeling for the day or she has a calendar you can follow so I don’t have to choose. Also, I am loving her live classes on Sundays. Give it a try you won’t regret it. Namaste.🧘‍♀️

I LOVE SarahBeth Yoga!. I’m so glad I found SarahBeth Yoga! SarahBeth is a wonderful teacher, with such a soothing voice. The app is easy to use. I love how everything is color-coded and the calendar has been perfect for me. I don’t have to figure out what yoga I’m going to do for the day with the calendar. I simply look at the calendar, touch the day/date and then it takes me right to the yoga video for that day. On the other hand, if I only want to do a few minutes of yoga, or meditation, that’s easy to find in the app as well. The community section in the app is also amazing. Everyone is on the same vibration it seems. It’s nice to connect with like-minded yogis. 🧘🩵

Thank you, Sarah Beth. Five years ago, I was trying to find a simple easy yoga session, just to meet a Yoga Day challenge. Having never ever done such a thing, I was looking for something geared towards a complete novice, and SBY popped up. I enjoyed my 15-minute practice so much, I came back to her YouTube videos again and again, until I realized that I wanted to be a part of the community. Once I joined, I’ve never looked back. The inclusiveness that I feel is a big part of why I love these. Not withstanding the workouts, I enjoy the genuine affection we all feel from Sarah Beth. Download this app, use it every day, join the community, and I promise your life will be the better for it.

Worth every penny!. I have been using SBY on YouTube for years and just could not see myself paying for the app when there are so many great videos available for free. Then a few months ago there was a discount offer for an annual membership so I thought I would give it a try. 

I love the little extras and my ability to create my own calendar or follow along with one that’s already curated in the app. I can also just choose my yoga for the day by the body part that needs focus or the time of day. Soooo helpful!! 

Best decision ever!! My only regret is not subscribing sooner.
It’s a lifestyle!. I travel a lot, and this app has really allowed me to take my practice wherever I go. Sarah is also an extremely intune soul, so every practice feels as if it’s personal.
Practice at my pace. I’m incredibly grateful for Sarah Beth Yoga! Her app, website, and YouTube channel have everything I need to practice at my pace.
Great app!. I love how organized her videos are and how her yoga style can be challenging and relaxing both at the same time! Please continue to make MORE videos!!! 🫶🏻🪷🧘🏻‍♀️

Great at home yoga. I live several miles from town, so it was important to me to find a yoga app that worked for me from home. I love how well Sarah Beth explains moves and the variety of yoga on the app.

Very thankful for SBY. I'm a 49-year-old male who up until about six months ago was very out of shape. I made a decision that change the course of my life. I started investing in myself. Utilizing Weight Watchers and Sarah Beth Yoga, i'm down, almost 60 pounds and feeling great. Very thankful to Sarah Beth for her pacing in her videos, but challenging also. I have encouraged many others to just take a little time and give it a shot. It is so worth it.

Love Sarah Beth - highly recommend!. I started following SarahBethYoga videos on YouTube when I was pregnant. Her videos helped relieve a lot of the back pain I tended to get during pregnancies, and they were the perfect way to wind down at the end of the day. I still try to fit in some yoga to wind down each day, and the app makes it as easy as it can be! There are videos in a wide range of times, so if all I have is 5 minutes, I can still get in a quick session. The library is extensive, and the community is great, too! The thing I LOVE about the app is the ability to attend live yoga sessions with Sarah Beth. She brings a thoughtful practice to us and sticks around afterwards to answer questions and chat through the comments. It’s like having a class with my favorite yoga teacher without having to travel. Definitely worth the investment.

Returning customer. I found SBY on YouTube, and loved the free videos. I began paying for the app and at some point decided I should save my money. After cancelling my subscription, I missed it, and am back again. It really is such a great value!

Great Yoga Videos. First - for the people giving 1 star reviews because they can’t figure out how to create an account 🙄... go to her website it’s not that difficult you’re just being lazy, and for the ones complaining about having to pay for a membership to use the app, cry me a river. This is how she makes a living people, you want free videos go to her YouTube channel, she designed the app to give more content and options to people willing to pay for it. You’re not willing to pay for it? Don't be petty and complain about it in a review. 

Now my actual review... she recently updated the app so this is my review of the newest version. I love it! It’s easy to filter videos and find ones for specific categories that I’m looking for be that “morning yoga,” a focus on legs, back, arms, a 10 min video - whatever it is the filter category is super helpful. There’s a favorites list which I also utilize quite a bit. There’s probably hundreds of videos on here and they go back to some of her earlier videos that I did like 5 years ago! I really like that I have access to 45-60 min videos on here. I do wish that there was a way to see recently viewed videos, it would be helpful in figuring out which video I want to do, because sometimes I don’t necessarily like a specific flow and don’t really want to do it again, and you can’t really weed those out once you’ve been doing them for a while all the little thumbnails look familiar lol. I’m also not a huge fan of the way she’s recently been releasing videos on the app. She puts up a 45 or 60 min flow which is great and then breaks that one class down into 3 or 4 more videos by taking segments of the longer class to make a shorter class. In theory it makes sense but I often find these classes don’t have a good flow and sometimes feels like the class is incomplete when it ends (which technically it is because it’s a segment from a longer class). I mean I get why she does it, less filming time, they just always feel more stilted than her older classes. But overall, the app is pretty user friendly, it’s easy to reset pw if you forget it, there’s a great selection of classes, and Sarah Beth is an awesome instructor!

All in all, great app!! Highly recommend it if you’re at all interested in yoga.

SarahBeth has changed my life.. SarahBethYoga has changed my life. Even though I’m only 25, I started having horrible back pain about a year ago. I stumbled upon SarahBeth one night while scrolling through Instagram. I liked how she had an assortment of different length videos. I decided I’d wake up 20 minutes earlier to do yoga before work. I started by just doing the free videos on YouTube. After about two weeks of doing so I noticed a huge difference in my back. I used to sit down to chart at work & could barely focus because my upper & lower back ached so badly. I would be counting down the minutes til I could clock out, go home, & lay in bed. But, after about two weeks of just 20 mins of yoga a day, I noticed that I really wasn’t bothered by my back unless it was an extremely physically tasking shift. 
Fast forward to three months & I’m just totally addicted. On Black Friday I splurged & bought the app, & I’m so happy I did! I do a 30 minute video before work. The hospital I work at actually has a small “prayer & meditation room” that I found & it’s always empty... So I take my mat to work & do a 20 minute stress relief or slow stretch video during my 30 minute lunch break. And then at night I usually do another 20 minute video before bed. On my days off work I’ll do a 45-60 minute video depending on how I’m feeling that day.
I crave the amazing feelings I experience during practice & after. It’s something that I look forward to immensely throughout my day. Being active in anyway has always felt like a chore to me, but not this! I’m constantly thinking if I have time for a little video or not, & trying to squeeze one in.
SarahBeth is so calming & an amazing instructor. I had never done yoga a day in my life before her. She explains positions in such simple detail that I hardly ever have to look up at the screen. My crazy stressful life needed SarahBethYoga more than I knew. My job is literally to care for others, & then when I’m home I dedicate myself to caring for my daughter, & then in my free time I dedicate myself to my future career by studying. I very rarely do anything just for me. Paying for a gym membership, finding the time to drive to class, getting childcare while I’m at class, not being able to go to a class on days I work because I work 12 hour shifts, etc... joining a yoga studio just isn’t realistic for me. But, SarahBethYoga gives me the time to just focus on me. Whether that’s for 10 minutes, 15 minutes, or 60 minutes... I get to just clear my mind, focus on my breath, and let go. My stress in life hasn’t gone away & it never will, but SarahBeth has given me a healthy outlet to release that stress. 
I was certain yoga would be physically beneficial, but I never knew it was going to be this mentally beneficial too. 
I don’t think I’ll ever stop doing SarahBethYoga & I am so grateful for finding her!
